promoCards.title: Gunslinger 20XX
powers: Remove an Ammo Token from this card. If you do, {Gunslinger} deals up to 3 targets 2 fire damage each. Otherwise, restore this card to its maximum Ammo.

promoCards.title: Dragon Champion Gunslinger (dragon form)
powers: Remove an ammo token from this card. If you do, {Gunslinger} deals 1 target 3 fire damage and up to 2 other targets 1 fire damage each. Then, if there are no Ammo Tokens on this card, switch to {Gunslinger}'s human character card.

promoCards.title: Dragon Champion Gunslinger
powers: Destroy one of your Equipment cards. Switch to {Gunslinger}'s dragon character card and move all Ammo Tokens from the destroyed card onto it.

cards.title: Gunslinger
powers: Play a one-shot. If you destroy a target this way, draw a card.

cards.title: Armed to the Teeth
body: Search your deck for up to 3 equipment cards. Put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck.

cards.title: Brace of Deringers
powers: Remove an Ammo Token from this card. If you do, {Gunslinger} deals 1 target 1 irreducible projectile damage, then deals 1 target 1 irreducible projectile damage. Otherwise, restore this card to its maximum Ammo.

cards.title: Double Tap
body: Use the power on one of your firearm cards twice.

cards.title: Fast Draw
body: Play a firearm card. Use the power on that card.

cards.title: Graven Bullet
body: The next damage dealt by {Gunslinger} is irreducible and increased by 2. Add 1 Ammo Token to one of your Firearm cards.

cards.title: Gun Cleaning
body: Draw a card. Restore one of your Firearm cards to its maximum Ammo. Increase damage dealt by {Gunslinger} by 1 until the end of your next turn.

cards.title: Guns Akimbo
body: You may use an extra power during your power phase.

cards.title: Lever Repeater
powers: Remove an Ammo Token from this card. If you do, {Gunslinger} deals 1 target 2 irreducible projectile damage. Otherwise, restore this card to its maximum Ammo.

cards.title: Modified Magazines
body: The maximum Ammo of your Firearm cards is increased by 1. When this card enters play, add 1 Ammo Token to each of your equipment cards.

cards.title: Navy Revolver
powers: Remove 1 Ammo Token from this card. If you do, {Gunslinger} deals 1 target 3 projectile damage. Otherwise, restore this card to it's maximum Ammo.

cards.title: Point Blank
body: Use the power on one of your firearm cards. If that power deals damage, increase it by 4.

cards.title: Sawn-Off Shotgun
powers: Remove 1 Ammo Token from this card. If you do, {Gunslinger} deals up to 3 targets 2 projectile damage each. Otherwise, restore this card to its maximum Ammo.

cards.title: Snap Shot
body: Use the power on one of your firearm cards. Draw 2 cards.

cards.title: The Whites of Their Eyes
body: The first time each turn {Gunslinger} is dealt damage by a non-hero target, you may use the power on one of your Firearm cards.

cards.title: Vicious Unload
body: Use the power on one of your non-character firearm cards repeatedly until there are no Ammo Tokens left on it. Destroy that equipment card and {Gunslinger} deals himself fire damage equal to the number of ammo tokens removed this way minus 1.
